|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Tatooine: Mos Espa (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-D-tatooinemosespa-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-tatooinemosespa022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' For remainder of game, sites may not deploy between this site and Watto's Junkyard. '''Dark Side:''' Your characters here and at Watto's Junkyard are immune to opponent's Sandwhirl.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tatooine: Mos Espa (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-tatooinemosespa6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “of game, sites may not” → “of game, may not”; “may not deploy between this site and Watto's Junkyard.” → “may not be separated from Watto's Junkyard.”; the card was uploaded as a portrait-format (rotated) image, 745×1039 pixels; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (490×350 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' For remainder of game, may not be separated from Watto's Junkyard. '''Dark Side:''' Your characters here and at Watto's Junkyard are immune to opponent's Sandwhirl.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tatooine: Mos Espa (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 11 July 2022<ref name="img-tatooinemosespa1d114e1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1d114e11aef35680bc775029d4203d1eae714fad commit 1d114e1] (11 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the card was re-uploaded in landscape format (1039×745 pixels), the same words and errata mark; the PC re-made the image at lower resolution (745×1039 → 1039×745 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark)”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “'''Light Side:''' For remainder of game, may not be separated from Watto's Junkyard. '''Dark Side:''' Your characters here and at Watto's Junkyard are immune to opponent's Sandwhirl.”
